Welcome to Long Meadow Golf Club, a private nine-hole club in Lowell, MA. On site: pro shop, function hall, bar, kitchen.

Event inquiry

House rules

  • Refund in full if event canceled at least 14 days before
  • A Member must sponsor all events; reservation final only upon payment, except Mercy Meal
  • Food menu orders must be completed no later than 8 days prior to event
  • Functions with more than 125 non-members require a Town of Tewksbury Police Officer
  • Graduation, Sweet 16, Jack & Jill, Confirmation, Baptism and Children's parties not accepted
